items.title: Python rejects $1.5M grant from U.S. govt. fearing ethical compromise
items.description: The Python Software Foundation (PSF) has withdrawn its $1.5 million grant proposal to the U.S. National Science Foundation (NSF) due to funding terms forcing a compromise on its commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.. [...]

items.title: Threat Actors Advertising Anivia Stealer Malware on Dark Web bypassing UAC Controls
items.description: A sophisticated information-stealing malware named Anivia Stealer has emerged on underground forums, marketed by a threat actor known as ZeroTrace. The malware represents a dangerous evolution in credential theft operations, specifically designed to compromise Windows systems from legacy XP installations through the latest Windows 11 environments. items.title: From Chef to CISO: An Empathy-First Approach to Cybersecurity Leadership
items.description: Myke Lyons, CISO at data-processing SaaS company Cribl, shares how he cooked up an unconventional journey from culinary school to cybersecurity leadership.
